name: ProfitGuard
author: Matches LLC

sections.description:
ProfitGuard adds profitability visibility to WooCommerce by combining product cost, payment fees, shipping assumptions, and ad spend assumptions into one clear view.

Key Features

  • Product-level Profit column in WooCommerce product list.
  • Break-even ROAS column for quick ad efficiency decisions.
  • Profit dashboard with summary stats and product breakdown.
  • Bulk cost editor with inline editing and markup tools for selected rows.
  • Settings to define default fee and cost assumptions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open ProfitGuard in wp-admin to configure settings and costs.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. ProfitGuard is built for WooCommerce products and requires WooCommerce to be active.

How are profits calculated?

Estimated profit uses:

Profit = Sale Price - (Product Cost + Payment Fee + Fixed Fee + Shipping Cost + Ad Cost)

Can I use ProfitGuard for free?

Yes. All features included in this package are available without license gating.
